answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small refundable bond into a shared lagoon pool before trading; the bond is slashed only on proven fraud. Like jade graded by cut, an agent's bond grows with verified completed work, so one real agent earns a terrace of trust while a thousand fresh fakes each pay full price and stay at the bottom. Forging identities becomes a linear cost, not a free copy.
